steps.title: Gather reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Collect all cell‑culture reagents (DMEM high‑glucose, DMEM/F12 1:1 with L‑glutamine, 15 mM HEPES, phenol‑red‑free, HBSS, DPBS, 0.5 % trypsin‑EDTA, penicillin‑streptomycin 10 000 U/mL, gentamicin 50 mg/mL, heat‑inactivated FBS, forskolin, poly‑L‑lysine, mouse laminin 1 mg/mL, PMA, EGFR/ErbB2 inhibitor 4557 W, anti‑S100β, anti‑GFAP, phospho‑MEK (Ser217/221), phospho‑tyrosine, Alexa‑Fluor 488/546 secondary antibodies, in‑house Thy1.1 antibodies, recombinant human heregulin‑β1 177–244, etc.) with catalog numbers as listed, and all disposable plasticware, 10‑cm culture dishes, laminin‑coated flasks, glass pipette with vacuum line, 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, Mini PROTEAN II electrophoresis cell (Cat #165‑2940), Mini Trans‑Blot module (Cat #170‑3935), PowerPac Basic power supply (Cat #164‑5050), PVDF membranes (Immobilon‑P, Cat #TM 151‑1), molecular‑weight marker (Fermentas Cat #SM1811), ECL Plus detection reagents (Cat #RPN2132), film (Amersham Hyperfilm ECL, Cat #28‑9068‑39), ImageJ software, GraphPad Prism v4, and all buffer components (10× Tris/Glycine/SDS, 10× Tris/Glycine, 10× TBS, Tween‑20, glycerol, DTT, bromophenol blue) with their catalog numbers.

steps.title: Prepare rat Schwann cell stock cultures
steps.instruction: Establish primary rat Schwann cell (SC) cultures from adult (3‑month‑old) female Fisher rat sciatic nerves and expand them to passage‑2 for cryostorage.

substeps.instruction: Dissect sciatic nerve, cut into small segments, and incubate 2–3 weeks in DMEM supplemented with 10 % heat‑inactivated FBS (DMEM‑10 % FBS).
Dissociate degenerated explants with 0.25 % dispase + 0.05 % collagenase.
Plate the resulting suspension on poly‑L‑lysine‑coated 10‑cm dishes in DMEM‑10 % FBS.
Remove contaminating fibroblasts by complement reaction using in‑house Thy1.1 antibodies.
Expand purified SCs in DMEM‑10 % FBS containing 2 µM forskolin, 20 µg/mL bovine pituitary extract, and 10 nM β1‑heregulin.
Grow cells to passage‑2, then cryopreserve in Recovery™ medium (DMSO : FBS = 1 : 9) and store at –80 °C.
Verify purity (>98 %) by immunostaining for S100β or GFAP and lack of Thy1.1.

steps.title: Prepare in‑process residual testing samples and controls
steps.instruction: Generate hSC‑conditioned medium, wash supernatants, and a full set of assay controls.

substeps.instruction: Culture connective‑tissue‑free endoneurial fascicles from donor sural nerves for 1 week in medium containing β1‑heregulin (10 nM) and forskolin (2 µM).
Dissociate fibers with collagenase and neutral protease, plate at low density on laminin‑coated flasks, and grow to ~70 % confluence.
Subculture under identical conditions, then detach cells and rinse three times with large volumes of serum‑free DMEM/F12.
Resuspend cells in transplantation solution (final product).
Collect supernatants:
a) hSC‑conditioned medium (from semi‑confluent cultures before trypsinization).
b) 2nd wash supernatant.
c) 3rd wash supernatant.
Snap‑freeze all collected supernatants on dry ice and store at –80 °C.
Prepare assay samples (all subjected to one freeze‑thaw cycle before use):
1) Negative control: DMEM/F12 alone.
2) Positive control: freshly prepared hSC growth medium (10 % FBS, 10 nM β1‑heregulin, 2 µM forskolin).
3) Serial dilutions of positive control in DMEM/F12 at 1:10, 1:100, 1:1 000, 1:10 000, and 1:100 000.
4) hSC‑conditioned medium (as collected above).
5) 2nd wash supernatant.
6) 3rd wash supernatant.
7) 3rd wash supernatant spiked with positive control at 1:10 and 1:100 ratios (tested in 2 of 3 runs).

steps.title: Stimulate rat SC assay cultures
steps.instruction: Add each prepared sample to cultured rat Schwann cells (seeded at appropriate density) and incubate for the assay‑defined period before lysate collection (incubation time not specified in the source).

steps.title: Prepare protein lysates and run Western blot
steps.instruction: Lyse stimulated rat SCs, separate proteins by SDS‑PAGE, transfer to PVDF, and probe with specific antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Rapidly aspirate culture medium with a glass pipette attached to a vacuum line.
Add 150 µL pre‑warmed (50 °C) SDS‑sample buffer (225 mM Tris/HCl pH 6.8, 5 % SDS, 50 % glycerol, 250 mM DTT, 0.5 mg/mL bromophenol blue) directly to each well.
Transfer lysate to 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and boil 10 min at 100 °C.
Prepare 10 % polyacrylamide gels (30 % acrylamide/bis‑acrylamide, 29:1) 1 mm thick, 15‑lane format.
Load 15 µL of each lysate per lane; load Fermentas molecular‑weight marker (Cat #SM1811) in first and last lanes.
Run electrophoresis at constant 80 V until bromophenol blue reaches the bottom (≈1.5–2 h).
Transfer proteins to Immobilon‑P PVDF membrane (Cat #TM 151‑1) using standard liquid transfer for ~2–3 h.
Block membrane 30 min in TBS‑T (0.05 % Tween‑20) containing 2 % ECL blocking reagent (Cat #RPN2125).
Incubate membranes overnight (~20 h) at 4 °C with primary antibodies diluted in ECL blocking solution:
• pAkt‑Ser‑473 (Santa Cruz, Cat #sc7985) 1:500
• pERK1/2/MAPK (Santa Cruz, Cat #sc7383) 1:500
• pErbB3‑Tyr‑1289 (Cell Signaling, Cat #4791S) 1:1000
• Akt (Cell Signaling, Cat #9272) 1:1000
• ERK2/MAPK (Santa Cruz, Cat #sc154) 1:500
• ErbB3 (Santa Cruz, Cat #sc285) 1:500
• Additional antibodies listed in Materials (all used at 1:500).
Rinse membranes 3 × with TBS‑T.
Incubate 1 h at room temperature with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibodies diluted 1:10 000 in ECL blocking solution (Goat anti‑mouse IgG‑HRP, Cat #sc‑2055; Goat anti‑rabbit IgG‑HRP, Cat #sc‑2301).
Wash membranes 3 × with TBS‑T.
Develop with ECL Plus detection reagents (Cat #RPN2132) and expose light‑sensitive film (Amersham Hyperfilm ECL, Cat #28‑9068‑39) for 1–30 min depending on signal intensity.

steps.title: Densitometric analysis of Western blot bands
steps.instruction: Quantify band intensities using ImageJ and express results relative to controls.

substeps.instruction: Scan exposed films at 300 dpi and convert images to grayscale.
Subtract background digitally in ImageJ.
Define regions of interest (ROIs) sequentially, starting with negative controls.
Measure band intensity using the area‑under‑curve method; generate profile plots where peak height reflects optical density.
For the 44/42 kDa doublet (P‑ERK/total ERK), quantify the combined rectangle.
Report data as arbitrary OD units relative to the negative control or as phospho‑/total‑protein ratios.
Exclude images with uneven or interrupted bands from analysis.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of assay data
steps.instruction: Analyze quantified data to determine significance of heregulin activity.

substeps.instruction: Enter mean ± SEM values (n = 3 independent experiments) into GraphPad Prism v4.
Perform one‑way ANOVA followed by Bonferroni’s post‑hoc test.
Consider results significant when * p < 0.05.

description: The main advantage of using cultures of rat SCs is that they are phenotypically stable and can be amplified substantially through serial passaging without becoming heregulin-independent [21]. By expanding SCs from adult rat nerves, it was feasible to prepare an excess of cells (> 1010 cells per batch) from a single well-characterized stock and store them by cryopreservation for use in all optimization and validation rounds essentially as if they were a cell line. For consistency, the batch of rat SCs used for the heregulin activity assays was investigated deeply for its responsiveness to β1-heregulin (Fig. 2a-e), the expression of phenotypic markers (shown for GFAP, Fig. 2c), and the lack of fibroblast contamination (as per Thy1.1 immunodetection, not shown). The identity of the cells was further examined by means of high throughput gene expression profiling (RNAseq), [7]. RNAseq data indicated a > 17-fold difference in the expression levels of ErbB3 and ErbB2 transcripts, whereas the expression levels of EGFR, ErbB4, EGF and NRG isoforms were negligible. The expression levels of selected transcripts (in RCPMs) were the following: Erbb2 (37.739 ± 1.141); Erbb3 (635.663 ± 27.444); Erbb4 (0.350 ± 0.0748); Egfr (0.139 ± 0.047); Nrg1 (0.253 ± 0.109); Nrg2 (0.450 ± 0.094); Nrg3 (0.106 ± 0); Nrg4 (0.146 ± 0.0355); Egf (0.335 ± 0.052). More information on the gene expression profiling of this batch of rat SCs can be found in the NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database (accession number GSE133716 and ID 200133716).
